title: Colours
label: ch:it-colours
canDo: I can name black, white, red and blue in Italian and say which of them Italian borrowed rather than inherited.

payoff.summary: Say nero, bianco, rosso and blu, add azzurro for gli Azzurri, and sort the four: nero and rosso inherited, bianco and blu Germanic loans, azzurro out of Arabic lāzaward.
